descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Milan puts you in the captain's seat over the real Lombardy.

THE REAL MILAN
Real satellite, elevation and map data: the Duomo and the gold Madonnina, the Galleria, La Scala, the Castello Sforzesco, the Arco della Pace, the Navigli, Torre Velasca, Centrale, the Pirelli tower, the Unicredit tower, Bosco Verticale, CityLife's three towers and San Siro.

MONZA, THE LAKES AND THE ALPS
Over Monza's circuit and the Villa Reale to Como's Duomo, Brunate and Lake Como, Varese's Sacro Monte, Lake Maggiore's Rocca di Angera and San Carlone, south to the Certosa di Pavia - with the Alps on the horizon.

BETWEEN THE CITYLIFE TOWERS
Low through the piazza between Isozaki's, Hadid's and Libeskind's towers.

A LIVING CITY
Trains on their real tracks, traffic on the real roads. At night the Duomo, Porta Nuova and San Siro light up.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
Taxi and takeoff clearances and your landing clearance.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar at Scalo Farini, Porta Nuova out of the doors. Walk around, repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with walk-through cabins, a midsize jet and a fighter.

ELEVEN MISSIONS
City approach, lakes approach, Malpensa hop, the Naviglio + Ticino run, the CityLife towers, Lake Como, a scramble, Milan by night, a city tour.

ENGLISH AND ITALIAN
Menus in English or Italian.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
